questions.prompt: What startling metabolic-health statistic does he cite for US adults?
choices: A Only 7% have any metabolic issue.
B About 93% of adults have some form of metabolic anomaly.
C Metabolic syndrome never clusters.
D Two-thirds have perfect labs.
questions.explain: About 93% have some metabolic anomaly; syndrome features raise disease risk.

choices: A Visceral fat is only under the skin of arms and legs.
